newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AUSDOC TO BUY NZ FREIGHT GROUP.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AUSDOC TO BUY NZ FREIGHT GROUP.

text.p: Business services company Ausdoc Group Ltd said on Thursday it has agreed to buy the express freight services business of New Zealand's Freightways Ltd for NZ$125 million.
Ausdoc said the purchase would be earnings per share positive in the first 12 months of ownership after amortisation of A$3 million in goodwill associated with the acquisition.
"Accordingly, the directors of Ausdoc believe that the acquisition will be strongly cash earnings per share positive from the outset," the company said in a statement.

Ausdoc said the business, the Express Freight Group (EFS), was the largest courier and express freight business in New Zealand. Its operations closely matched those of Ausdoc in Australia and included the New Zealand document exchanges and records managements services.
EFS had gross revenues of about NZ$160 million in the year ended March 31, 1997, and earnings before interest and tax of about NZ$17.1 million.
